evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No historical reference has been established; observations begin at contract activation.
evidenceCoverage.reason: Prospective goal contract without an established historical reference.

caveat: The evidence measures repository outcomes against a frozen goal, not the causal impact of an agent or contract activation.

intent.goal: For original mechanical CI defects on main, restore the same required failing condition by a landed minimal fix, independently verified without bypass, measured as distinct defects repaired per non-overlapping period.
intent.acceptance: An original protected native failure and an exercised pass under the same predicate, required check, toolchain, scope and suppression policy; immutable main landing and ordered receipts. A PR, merge, green job, self-healing run or agent evaluation alone is insufficient.

evidence.opportunity: Distinct original mechanical failing conditions on main, independently established by a required ci.yml check; infrastructure/transient failures and later introduced defects are separate.
filters: Frozen current-source profile only; never reinterpret an unknown historical intent era.
Original condition identity is frozen before repair: rule, logical locus, predicate and failing input class; never PR, run, test count or an editable tracking marker.
The first landed and independently verified repair of a condition is delivered once. Repeats, reruns, later receipts and duplicate PRs do not redeliver it.
Count all actors. Avenger contribution additionally needs an independent producer/implementation linkage; body markers alone remain discovery.
Skipped, masked, waived, deleted, weakened, setup-failed or differently configured checks do not establish a repair.
evidence.collection: Offline digest-checked retained source, condition catalogue, Git ancestry/landing and protected native check receipts. No commands from the target repository, remote APIs, lazy fetch or workflow execution.

sourceProfile.historicalReadiness: Addition is verified against the actual parent, not a shallow boundary. No historical native baseline established; reconstruction is not exhausted. Current predicates are not backdated to adoption.

nativeAcceptance.catalogue: An independently adjudicated pre-repair catalogue must join equivalent diagnostics to the same original condition. Ambiguous root-cause identity stays incomplete, not one defect per failing testcase.
nativeAcceptance.unsupported: Other native formats and unreviewed source/checker eras remain incomplete and cannot imply zero repairs.
nativeAcceptance.predicateIdentity: Hash the complete native assertion closure, including test assertions, frozen golden expectations, normalization, exclusions and expected results. The producer must retain source/input inclusion proofs at both heads; a bare self-declared hash or changed expected fixture is not an oracle.
nativeAcceptance.evidenceTrust: Retained protected-producer projections are an explicit external evidence trust boundary. Digests verify integrity, not remote authenticity or causal condition equivalence. A future producer must bind actual platform job, branch policy, logs/artifacts, source/input inclusion and protected condition catalogue before emitting these envelopes; no such producer evidence is retained here.
nativeAcceptance.requiredCheck: Retained requirement receipt at both heads must bind the same CI job/matrix/predicate to protected branch requirements; an Actions success is not evidence it was required.
nativeAcceptance.fullGoal: Native repair plus protected passing make fmt, make lint, make test-unit and all applicable non-tolerated CI assertions at the landed revision, with complete introduced-defect assessment and zero introductions. Local sampled test-unit is not exhaustive CI recovery.
safeguards: make test-unit defaults to a 30-second impacted sample, up to five top-level tests per impacted package; a successful sample cannot prove the original failure was exercised.
Wasm golden normalization and graceful skips mean suite success or regenerated expected bytes alone is insufficient; require the unchanged original subtest to pass without a skip.
Race-detector CI is schedule-only and continue-on-error; explicitly disabled marketplace and negative-control GH_HOST reproduction are not buildability proofs.

Lint includes stale locks, skill paths, gofmt, JSON/JS formatting, syntax, golangci, model aliases, no-python shell checks, shellcheck and stale schema binary. A skipped golangci check remains incomplete.
Workflow files are excluded from safe-output PRs. File guards (>50 recompile, >80 staged), 8-minute budget and 50 turns are process safeguards, not repair quantities.
nativeAcceptance.maturation: No invented waiting period; deliver only after landing and independent pass are both observed. Later discovery cannot move delivery into an earlier period.

model.architecture: Native condition-level proof pairs, with separate progress, full acceptance, regression, incompleteness and contribution channels.
model.recommendation: Not rated: no source-defined keep bar, accepted native history or matching costs. Acquire only coordinator-approved bounded missing inputs.

metrics.name: Independently demonstrated introduced defects
metrics.formula: Distinct newly introduced conditions with an independently passing predecessor and failing landed successor, delivered once at max(failure completion, evidence availability); null without exhaustive coverage.

metrics.name: Conditions with incomplete check evidence
metrics.formula: Original conditions established in this interval whose native check/landing proof remains incomplete at observedAt; null without catalogue coverage. Not a count of failed runs.

dispositions.primary: Count repaired original mechanical conditions independently of actor.
dispositions.diagnostic: Keep full buildability, introduced defects, unresolved checks and demonstrated contribution separate; never subtract or average them into progress.
dispositions.antecedent: Original mechanical CI defects and repairs pre-exist Avenger; exact current-source history has not been reconstructed. Baseline unavailable is not exhausted or zero.
